title: Timeline with Bars

illustrates.quote: Timeline with Bars. Insert the range of years when bars are used to indicate a span of time. Usually it is necessary to provide an estimate of the dates. Include a transcriber’s note to let the reader know all dates are approximate. Place the note on the Transcriber’s Notes page when these types of timelines are used throughout the volume.

print.notes: The full print timeline runs from 1600 to beyond 1725 with more events than this book excerpt transcribes (figure.labels lists several — Reign of Louis XIV, Peter the Great, The Glorious Revolution, John Locke/Hobbes/Racine — that this specific braille excerpt omits, marked with the book's own ellipsis, '444', between 'Official recognition of the Dutch Republic' and the final '1725' tick); there is no print-side input to build that ellipsis from, matching the same documented, non-defect excerpt-truncation convention used throughout this gold corpus (see e.g. section-4/section-8 READMEs). Entries are transcribed in chronological order by start year (6.10.1), not the print's own layout order. F-170 (BANA 6.10.1a's 'begin a timeline on a new braille page') is not itself exercised by this excerpt (it opens mid-page in the book's own worked example), but still applies generally to this rule area.
print.printFeatures: A horizontal-bar timeline with a year axis (1600-1725ish) and labelled event bars/points.

braille.notes: Flat 1-3 list (cell 1 / cell 3 runover). 444 marks the book's own excerpt ellipsis between the last transcribed event and the final '1725' tick — not print content.

resolution: A and B agreed byte-for-byte, but share two errors, both confirmed by decoding the raw source directly (source-6.txt lines 5033-5047): (1) the transcriber's note's own margins are given as 5/3, when the raw source shows exactly 6/4 (the standard BANA 7-5 note margins used consistently throughout this section); (2) both runs silently DROPPED the book's own '444' excerpt-ellipsis line between the Dutch-Republic entry and the final '1725' tick, replacing it with a blank line — restored here from the raw source. All bar-range dates and event text confirmed correct by exact forward-translation (e.g. '1615-1660 English, French, Dutch settle North America' and '1645 Official recognition of the Dutch Republic' both reproduce their braille lines exactly); print.blocks[1] (the actual transcribable list) was built here since neither run supplied one, only a flat, undated figure.labels array with no structure.
